newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates mostly lower on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates mostly lower on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly lower in thin Thursday dealings on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none Wednesday.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), bid 155 percent of tariff, offered 175 percent.
- One barge, next week, lower Ohio River, bid 180 percent, offered 190 percent, similar unchanged.
- Four barges, two each week of September 22 and September 29, Mid-Mississippi, bid 195 percent, offered 210 percent, down 10 percentage points, similar.
- Eight barges, two each week of October, Illinois River, bid 225 percent of tariff, down five percentage points, similar, offered 245 percent, unchanged.
- Eight barges, two each week of October, Mid-Mississippi, bid 230 percent, down 10 percentage points, similar, offered 245percent, down five percentage points.
- Four barges, one each week of November, Illinois river, bid 200, down five percentage points, similar, offered 207-1/2 percent, down five percentage points.
